notes.title: EvilPunk 2.0 "New West"
notes.content:
We are offering you a brand new gameplay with this EvilPunk 2.0 "New West" Rogue-like update that we have been working on since the 1.4.2 update. Unlike the tower defense in the Campaign mode, in the Rogue-like mode, you will fight different enemies on procedurally generated and linear maps and collect cards that will offer you different gameplay mechanics as you collect them at the end of these battles.

Of course, we made a huge visual change in the game with the 2.0 Update. In order to reflect the wild west spirit of the game, we rearranged the structure of the surrounding houses, the ground and the lighting to be compatible.

We are sharing a small sample with you and invite you to play our new game mode to see more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/c77a92ba3361e6ab47d2644e9dbc88f69544e525.png[/img]

And now let's take a look at the content we added to the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/397b748cfac1a042fbec2da5ba7257161e61a502.png[/img]

[b][h1]Rogue-like Mode[/h1][/b]
Our new game mode that you can access from the Main Menu!

You can play this new mode in 2 different difficulty levels.[list]
[b][h3]Normal Mode[/h3][/b]
[*]In Normal mode, your death is not permanent. You will access to the Skill Tree and your Skill Tree upgrades will be carry over your next runs. Your highest score will be saved to the Leaderboard.
    [*]We also have a Starting Town specific to Normal mode, where you can access the Skill Tree, try out weapons at the shooting range, and hang out at the Saloon and have fun.

[b][h3]Hardcore Mode[/h3][/b]
    [*]In Hardcore mode, your death is permanent. Everything you did in this run will be gone, you have no advantages over Normal mode and you can’t access to the Skill Tree. Your highest score will be saved to the Leaderboard.

[h3]Combat Level[/h3]
    [*]As you progress through the levels, you will encounter different Combat Levels. You must fulfill the necessary conditions to progress.
    
    [b]Exterminate[/b]
        [*]You need to kill a certain number of enemies in a level. You cannot move on to the next level without killing all of them.

    [b]Survival[/b]
        [*]In this Level, you need to survive from the enemy horde for 1 minute. When the time is up, your passage to the next Level will be unlocked.

    [b]Boss Level[/b]
        [*]You fight with a random boss you encounter in Campaign mode. When you defeat the boss, you will be able to move on to the next level.

    [b]Level End Rewards[/b]

        [b]Normal Mode[/b]
            [*]Combat Level: Silver Coin, Gear Coin and Crystal
            [*]Boss Level: Silver Coin, Gear Coin and Crystal
            [*]One Card Chest every 2 combat levels.
              You need to choose one of the 3 Buff Cards from the reward chest.

       [b]Hardcore Mode[/b]
            [*]Combat Level: Silver Coin and Gear Coin
            [*]Boss Level: Silver Coin and Gear Coin
            [*]One Card Chest every 2 combat levels.
                You need to choose one of the 3 Buff Cards from the reward chest.

[h3][b]Buff Cards[/b][/h3]
    [*]From reward chests at the end of every 2 combat Levels. Collect over 40 cards that will give you a different ability each time and create your own unique play style.
    [*][b]You can access the card slots by turning your left hand.[/b]

        [b]Normal Mode[/b]
            [*]You start the game with 5 card slots. You can open the 6th slot with the Skill Tree.

        [b]Hardcore Mode[/b]
            [*]You start the game with 6 card slots.

    [b]Damage[/b]
       [*]Cards in this category are Damage-focused cards that increase your damage to enemies in the game and shape your damage type.

    [b]Shield[/b]
        [*]Cards in this category are Defense-focused cards that aim to keep you alive and reduce damage from enemies.

    [b]Heal[/b]
        [*]Cards in this category are cards that focus on healing, recovering your health and giving high rewards for low health.

    [b]Freeze[/b]
        [*]Cards in this category are Freeze-focused cards that restrict and stop your enemies movements.
    
[b]Summon[/b]
        [*]Cards in this category are Summon-focused cards that strengthen the objects you have summoned during your level and change their effects.

    [b]Utility[/b]
        [*]Cards in this category are Utility-focused cards that increase your supply control and give effects to your enemies.

[h3][b]Skill Tree[/b][/h3]
    [*]This skill tree, which is only available in Normal Mode, will permanently grant you special abilities in exchange for the Crystals you earn at the end of the each level.

[h3][b]Event Level[/b][/h3]
    [*]In this Level, which you will encounter as you progress in Rogue like mode, is focused entirely on giving you rewards or punishments according to the actions you take.

   [b]Written Events[/b]
        [*]By telling you a storyline, you will receive a reward or punishment, or nothing will happen, depending on the option you choose.

    [b]Interactive Events[/b]
        [*]A plot is presented to you and depending on your actions or luck, you receive a reward or punishment, or nothing happens.

[h3][b]Shop Level[/b][/h3]
    [*]Unlike the campaign mode, when you reach this level, a random shop will appear and you can buy or upgrade cards, weapons and consumables with the Silver Coins you have.

    [b]Item Shop[/b]
        [*]You can buy Health, Ammo, Turret, Grenade and consumables with different prices and health recovery values.

    [b]Card Shop[/b]
       [*]You can purchase different numbers of random rarity cards depending on the mode you are in.
         [*][b]Normal Mode[/b]
            You can buy 3 cards. You can buy 6 cards with Skill Tree.
          [*][b]Hardcore Mode[/b]
            You can buy 6 cards.

    [b]Card Upgrade[/b]
        [*]You can upgrade the cards you have.

    [b]Weapon Shop[/b]
        [*]You can buy more powerful weapons that you can use during the level.

    [b]Weapon Upgrade[/b]
        [*]You can upgrade and strengthen the weapon you have during the level.

[h3][b]Headshot Combo[/b][/h3]
    [*]In Roguelike mode, consecutive kills with Headshots will give you extra rewards.
         3x combo: Silver Coin
         5x combo: Silver Coin and Score
         8x combo: Silver Coin, Score and Maximum Health
    [*]The Maximum Health reward will remain with you until you die.

[b][h1]Enemy[/h1][/b]
[*]Flying enemy types that are difficult to reach and hit in the air have been added to the game.
         Eagle
         Bat

[*]An enemy type that will come to you quickly and make it difficult for you to escape has been added to the game.
         Wolf

[b][h1]Environment[/h1][/b]
[*]Environmental interaction has been added to the game where you can get rewards by digging graves in Town and Level.
    [*]You can earn consumables and silver coins by digging graves with the shovel that spawns with cemeteries.
[*]Cigarette, Alcohol and Canned Food consumables, which can be found in Town and Level and give you health when consumed, have been added to the game.

[b][h1]Leaderboard[/h1][/b]
[b]Your score will be recorded in different leaderboards depending on the mode you play.[/b]
[b]Normal Mode[/b]
    [*]It is located in Town next to the Train Station.
[b]Hardcore Mode[/b]
    [*]It is located next to the Level entrance gate as you exit the train station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/19d7f890068e228479aecb83952ce3c2fa62c1e8.png[/img]
[*]After pressing the button to set the Turret, it is automatically canceled 5 seconds later. You no longer have to set up the Turret.
[*]You can now interact with most UI interactions by clicking directly on the UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/247699071f35eb69f208ea52e7b81fdcb3e1b32c.png[/img]
[*]We now have new header images for patch notes!
[*]Lighting, models and environments have been revamped on all Campaign maps!
     The Church
     Level 1
     Level 2
     Level 3
     Level 4
[*]There's a new starting town exclusive to the Rogue like’s Normal mode!
[*]Melee zombies now have new models!
[*]Turret's model has been renewed!
[*] Tutorial Signs have been renewed!
[*]The chests have been renewed!
[*]The piano has been renewed!
[*]Appearance of weapons have been polished!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/37790a8846aadd6ea10f20b94bb7a0988b265ede.png[/img]
[*]Tutorial signs have been renewed. They now have a cleaner, more readable UI. 
[*]The UI has been updated to appear when you approach the books on the map.
[*]In Rogue like mode, you can access your currency and card slots by turning your Left hand and current level, duration and score information by turning your Right hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/77b4b51d9cbdbf21556b6b9bdccedd9d53a9cf53.png[/img]
[*]Enemy movement behavior has been smoothed out, they now turn more naturally when turning left and right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/7883ebea3d1cfed34ad223be2a19d2096faf04df.png[/img]
[*]Enemy drop rates have been adjusted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/0eb83fcd6cfa0f87fd706d202eb06b0565d19e0e.png[/img]
[*]Fixed some known bugs in Campaign mode.[/list]

[b]If you experience any issues, please delete the AppData\Local\VRGKVirtualRealityGameKit file.[/b]

notes.title: Rogue-Like Mode Beta Test!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're looking for testers for our EvilPunk's Rogue-like Mode. As part of this test, we’d love your help in making the game even better!

We’ll send you a Steam Test key to try out Rogue-like Mode. Let us know how the game performs on your setup and share your thoughts!

Thanks in advance, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Dev Diary #04 | Procedural Levels and Rogue Like Mode
notes.content:
Welcome back to EvilPunk development diary!

With realese of 1.4.1 and 1.4.2 updates in previous weeks, we added the close range weapon to the game, which will add innovation to our gameplay, and we fixed many issues and made improvements, including the stutter problem. We also gave a small preview of the Rogue-like mode developments in a Dev Diary #03.

With a few weeks left until the release of our Rogue-like mode, we want to talk about what we have done so far.

[b]Procedural Level Generation[/b]

We wanted to make the Roguelike experience different from the current Campaign mode. To do this, we switched to a Procedural Level Generation system instead of pre-made maps, so players would feel different every time they played.

Based on the examples you will see in the pictures, this system will present you with different environmental models and position these environmental models in different ways every time you progress on the map. The objects you can interact with outside and inside these environmental models and enemy spawn locations will also be completely random.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/bcee54b59eaa8229abcd3d305a1b76bb772c0421.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/90447f31497837556daf0713d90b527230c3881c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/bcee54b59eaa8229abcd3d305a1b76bb772c0421.png[/img]
Of course, we will not only use Procedural Level Generation to generate maps where you will fight randomly. It will also be used for special areas that will be included in the Rogue-like mode. We can’t give much information about these special areas at the moment, but you will be able to experience the game mode when it is released!

[b]Rogue-like Mode[/b]

As we mentioned before, we gave a small preview of the Roguelike mode developments in Dev Diary #03. We want to offer a completely new experience to those playing Roguelike mode.

For this reason, we started our work with the question of how we can make the campaign and roguelike mode different. We couldn't expect players to feel different just by adding new abilities to the game. Even if we added new abilities, doing the same things on the same maps just a little differently wouldn't offer any experience or improvements. As we mentioned in our previous topic, we switched to Procedural Level Generation for this reason. In addition, we plan to improve our existing enemies and add new enemy variety.

So what are these abilities we just mentioned? As you progress through the maps and complete events on the maps in the roguelike mode, rewards await you at the end of the map. These end-of-map rewards can be random items in the game, money, or skill cards that will add innovation to your gameplay.

You can get these ability cards at certain map ends, as in the example image, or from special areas we mentioned earlier!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/c0f3889b04f7dd742fc0b4c3a349ab2b6c912085.jpg[/img]
We plan to add more variety to your gameplay experience not only with skill cards but also with the Skill Tree and different difficulty modes!

We plan to release it in the 2nd week of February and we invite you to experience this new Rogue-like mode with us!

That’s all for today. See you on the next dev diary!

notes.title: Hotfix v1.4.2 Update!
notes.content:
[h2]EvilPunk Hotfix 1.4.2 Patch Notes[/h2]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.4.1!
notes.content:
[b]Evil Punk Hotfix 1.4.1 Patch Notes [/b]

Our latest hotfix 1.4.1 is here, adding major changes, addressing bugs, improving features, and setting the stage for a smoother gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new: 

 

[b]Major Changes [/b]

[b]Flickering/Shaking Problem Fixed! 

Melee Weapon Added [/b]

[list]
[*] Killing an enemy with a melee weapon now guarantees a magazine drop! 
[/list]

 

[b]Improvements [/b]

[b]Enemy Drops: [/b]

[list]
[*] Collected Grenades now automatically go to the belt. So you don’t have pick them up manually. 
[*] Duration of drops is now visible with effects. 
[*] The 3D objects and their effects have been adjusted. 
[/list]

[b]Level 3- Boss: [/b]

[list]
[*] Only the active tower is now highlighted with a light. 
[*] The special attack effect has been changed. Boss now creates hurricanes. 
[/list]

[b]Shop Wave: [/b]

[list]
[*] Item stats and their effects are now displayed on the item card. 
[*] After weapon purchase, newly spawned magazines go directly to the player’s belt. 
[/list]

[b]Wave System: [/b]

[list]
[*] The end wave now displays a "Boss Wave" warning. 
[*] During shop waves, players are warned with a "Go to church" message. 
[/list]

[b]Weapon Purchase:[/b] 

[list]
[*] Weapon stats are now permanently displayed on top of the weapons. 
[*] Weapons purchased from the Wave Shop replace the previous weapon correctly. 
[*] You can now try your weapon in the polygon area with unlimited ammo spawns in the shooting area. 
[/list]

[b]Shotgun: [/b]

[list]
[*] Shotgun pump sound is now manual. 
[*] Shotgun magazines now correctly go to the player’s belt. 
[/list]

[b]Weapons: [/b]

[list]
[*] Weapon recoils have increased when held with one hand. 
[*] Automatic weapon sounds have been rearranged. 
[/list]
[b]Grenades: [/b]

[list]
[*] Players can now place grenades on both sides of the belt. 
[/list]

[b]UI: [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a "Restart Level" option to the death screen. 
[*] Wave sign adjustments have been made. 
[*] Design adjustments have been implemented. 
[/list]
[b]
Settings: [/b]

[list]
[*] Graphic settings are now saved and loaded in-game. 
[/list]

[b]Camera Shake: 
[/b]
[list]
[*] Camera shake has been disabled when zombies hit the player.
[/list] 

[b]Gun Shop: [/b]

[list]
[*] Gun price displays have been fixed. 
[/list]

[b]Height Adjustment: [/b]

[list]
[*] Players can now arrange their height. 
[/list]

[b]Input: [/b]

[list]
[*] Jumping has been removed and replaced with the settings screen. 
[*] Inputs are now compatible with Steam VR. 
[/list]

[b]Turrets: [/b]

[list]
[*] Turrets now have muzzle effects. 
[/list]

[b]Main Menu: [/b]

[list]
[*] Added an "Exit" button. 
[/list]

 

[b]Bugfixes [/b]

[list]
[*] Starting Revolver bullets now automatically come to the player’s belt at the start of the game. 
[*] Belt and player height options are now saved and loaded in-game. 
[*] The in-game player and menu player positions have been corrected. 
[*] Wave Shop prevents item purchases when item slots are full, and players no longer lose money. 
[*] Wave Shop weapons purchased now have proper damage values. 
[*] Magazine count no longer goes into negative values. 
[*] AK-47 and SMG material issues have been fixed during upgrades.

notes.title: Dev Diary #03 | Hotfix 1.4 Released and Rogue Like
notes.content:
Welcome back to Evil Punk development diary. With update 1.4 released in previous week. Most game breaking bugs are fixed and optimization issues mostly handled. Except stutter in church.
 
Today we are going to focus on whats coming in 1.4.1 patch, what we achieved in 1.4 release and Rogue like update.
 
 
In 1.4 patch we fixed sizeable amount of bugs glitches and performance issues.
 
Also since our starting area looks more like a polygon area than a church, we wanted to make this work with our game. Of course, our area was very large and players got lost easily, so we reduced the area by a third and focused on just what the player needed to see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/cf51faef4c419dd4c874780ef4b72091cd49a2c6.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/628c71f277da66a8eb8f3757882bb921afebdd60.png[/img]
We also tried to make a map selection screen that was out of the ordinary, but we got feedback from the player base about how difficult it was to select a map and it also didn't give enough information about the level. So we redesigned the Level Select screen to make it easy to enter the map with just two clicks and to see all the map information at a glance for you to better understand!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/eb3631ed3edee8b54facb1d1d72a152e4e08ca89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/98ae8d3304f1b50f90920f7b507c7102c8dba1a3.png[/img]
(Also we added a timer to our wave indicator!)
 
 In addition, according to the feedbacsk, it was not fully understood what the power-ups falling from the enemies were due to their visual effects. We adjusted the effects to make them more visible and to make their shapes more obvious.
 
About our next updates Rogue like game mode is on the process of development and planned to release in January.
 
Right now we can only show you how our freeze cards effects work on our turret.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/9511764503122e0c31d182311516d56404566ddb.png[/img]
(Work In Progress)
 
Also about this week we are gona release another and final hotfix patch called 1.4.1 for remaining bugs and glitches. We are also trying to solve stutter issues on some devices!
 
We will continue to collect your feedback and make adjustments and fixes as a result. For now though, that’s all for today. See you on the next dev log!

notes.title: HOTFIX v1.4
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Sheriffs,[/b]
We’ve just released a new Major Hotfix to enhance your gaming experience and address some of the feedback we’ve received from our amazing community. Below is a detailed list of the improvements and fixes included in this update:
 
[b]Improvements:[/b]
 
[b]Starting Area:[/b] First of all, we completely redesigned our Starting Area, reducing its size and making it more functional. And now you can also try out the grenades and turrets available in the game in the Shooting Range! (Even our Priest standing in the church is shocked by this situation and looks like he won't be able to speak for a while.)
[b]Level Select:[/b] We've completely removed the 3D map table and replaced it with a more informative and easy to understand UI.
[b]Tutorial:[/b] We've updated our Tutorial screens with a new start area. We've tried to make it more understandable for everyone with less text and more icons.
[b]Sitting Mode: [/b]In Pause Menu you can now adjust the Belt's height, left and right, and forward and backward.
[b]UI Improvements & Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed extra health indicators on weapons. And the icons for church and player lives have been changed to make them easier to distinguish.
[*] When you deal damage to an Enemy, a grey bar now appears on their health bar.
[*] The quality of the money labels in the game has been improved. and now our money appears on every table in the Wave Shop.
[*] Pause Menu, the win and die screen now has "Return to Base and "Level Select" options.
[*] The time you spend on the level is now visible on the Wave Board.
[*] There is now a Master Setting in the Pause Menu.
[*] Fixed the range of increased stat values in the Upgrade Table.
[/list]
[b]Grenades:[/b] The throwing power has been increased to make it easier to throw.
[b]Bosses[/b]
[list]
[*] The footsteps of the Boss on the first map are no longer global. It has been made easier to understand where it comes from.
[*] We reduced the effects of the boss in the first map to improve performance.
[*] The attacks of the Boss on the second map have been improved.
[*] Weapons in Shop Wave: The magazines that come with purchasing a weapon in Shop Wave have been positioned more clearly and their number has been increased.
[/list]
 
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Let's start with the most annoying ones first.
[*] Fixed the issue where bombs could not be thrown and would go underground when thrown.
[*] Fixed the issue where objects falling in the church area would go underground.
[*] Fixed the issue where health drops from enemies were not being picked up properly.
[*] Fixed the UI overlay issue when the magazine is placed on the belt.
[*] Last Enemy Indicator: The last remaining enemy on the map being displayed in red now works properly.
[*] Fixed the issue where Turrets would exceed their maximum limit when purchased from Shop Waves and chests.
[*] Fixed the issue where a Tank zombie would go into strange animations when it was shot in the leg area.
[*] Fixed the issue where ranged enemies could not hit us while in Seated Mode.
[*] The issue where church and player health was not reaching its maximum value when gaining health in Shop Wave has been fixed, and the damage sound is no longer played when buying player health.
[*] Fixed the issue where bosses could not gain shields at certain health levels. This way, boss phases are now working properly. (They won't die that easily anymore)
[/list]
 
 
Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We’re committed to making EvilPunk the best experience it can be. As always, please let us know your thoughts on these updates in the Steam Community Hub or through our social media channels.
 
[b]Stay tuned for more updates, and enjoy your time in the world of EvilPunk!
 
Best regards,
The EvilPunk Team[/b]

notes.title: EvilPunk Dev Diary #02
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
Welcome to the second page of the EvilPunk Developer Diary!
In this article we will talk about our Enemies, Map Interaction and Wave System.

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
While making a zombie-themed game based on the Steam Punk concept, we changed these values significantly compared to the previous demo. Before starting the project, we had created upper limits for the wounds, bloodshed and brutality of the zombies in our art style. However, later on, we decided to have a "tense/mystical" feeling and be close to the dark western theme for the ambiance.

At this stage, we reworked the models and textures of the zombies - again taking our art style into account - with a more detailed understanding in order to capture the tense feeling. For the mystical part, we produced new non-zombie demon enemy types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/8a7d134385fb867fb78b74c6fe8639d2e94cfa83.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/2802f4bf86b4d65e6f3e3cdbb9097714f9b8d6fe.jpg[/img]

[h2]Map Interaction[/h2]
We felt that our maps in the previous demo were small and insufficient for the player's gameplay. So we changed and rearranged many of our maps. We also implemented new maps that we had in mind.

The main focus of these maps is a church that we have to defend, an area around us that we can explore within the maps, collectible chests in this area and a tense environment that you can feel in your bones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/e513fcf7b3738ddd2f2cc649a8de32ad1291867f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/afefc049b1fc21761d7900a7cfc138e50595cdbd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/d21cff46404b88a96f6c5395d709f2ec829c00cf.png[/img]

[h2]Wave System[/h2]
We also felt compelled to rework the spawn system of Waves. Previously, enemies would spawn around the player and in places they weren't looking. However, to make this more optimized and compatible with our maps, we placed spawn points in certain areas. This way, we made it more understandable which direction the player should defend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/786f344d679378dfa34592d4c20b6010711cb353.jpg[/img]

See you in the next dev diary.

notes.title: EvilPunk Dev Diary #01
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Welcome to the first page of the EvilPunk Developer Diary!

[h2]What will we talk about in the EvilPunk Developer Diary?[/h2]
As we continue to develop the game, we will periodically share with you the improvements, updates and progress of the game that have been made so far and will be coming from now on in order not to leave you in the dark.

[h2]So, what have we done so far?[/h2]
Since the demo version of the game, we've gone through an intensive period. Our design team has been planning many improvements and new features for the game, while our development team has been working on numerous bug fixes and integrating these updates into the game. Meanwhile, our art team has been busy creating new models, animations, and maps.

We are working hard to provide the game to users with as few bugs as possible. We have also established a feedback system through social media to collect feedback from the community and address any issues within the game.

[h2]Improvements we have made to the game so far[/h2]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
Since the main focus of EvilPunk is the weapon experience, our team started by working on the weapons. While we aimed to bring the weapons into the game as realistically as possible, we didn’t know how challenging this development process would be. Every new development brought new problems, sensations, and experiences.

The biggest problem we experienced was the shaking and the problems of getting stuck when shouldering the weapon. We solved these problems by optimizing the in-game models and improving controller calibrations.

When the first development phase of the revolver was completed, we faced some gameplay issues. We felt that something was missing with the revolver. To identify the cause of this feeling, we reviewed the shortcomings. One of the most noticeable problems was that the ammo count on the user interface didn’t match the number of rounds in the revolver’s chamber. We fixed this by displaying the rounds in the revolver’s mesh.

Another issue with the revolver was the reloading system. While all the other weapons reload manually, we made the revolver reload automatically. The reason for this change was that having the player load the revolver while fighting off zombies would negatively affect the player experience and disrupt the flow of the game. Our improvements weren’t limited to the revolver; we also worked on all the other weapons and updated their visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/422dde9b3789b3971f8e3344691322120ba9185a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/e44b4de218ad30fe44931ba25da0cd940c652748.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/82202a8138f560565419a0a7dcaf6730f90e7317.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/5f6480fcea5681320d89701eb76d659493e9ef1e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/b7311dff4c09fa8d7b0e0bc3a899e80b2d8d3917.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/71f3eb88b5b18eed5cc7447b29d0336c3c6f2d67.jpg[/img]

[h3]Belt[/h3]
In the first version of our belt system, different belts were used for pistols and rifles. This caused unnecessary time delays in the background. Additionally, the items worn by the player (such as weapons, bombs, magazines, etc.) were not displayed correctly on the belt, negatively affecting the player’s experience. After identifying the flaws with the belt system, we designed a better belt to fix these issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/b82b753cff8386632658164acb966eb84cbdada8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Polygon[/h3]
In this area, you can experience each weapon, buy them, and upgrade them. You can also talk to Priest Marcus to learn the story of EvilPunk.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/abcdec89efcce5a4783535355e72363c106a0520.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/788b9ade97e59df605f53f2939ff092100aeadec.jpg[/img]

Additionally, you can play the piano that belonged to Salomon’s brother, High Priest John. (Please be careful not to hurt anyone’s ears…)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/767ab3c3dddc992c4f6995c70ac59309b5991e63.jpg[/img]

When you're ready, talk to Priest Marcus again, select your next adventure location on the map, and begin your journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004153/9af4f12d956edc5bab129d87d34fa4a22b6bcd95.jpg[/img]
